names_flaws.span: Lighting, clutter, similar-looking items, unlabeled leftovers, and expiration dates are hard. Users will abandon after a few wrong “you have 3 onions” results.

A week of meals needs variety, leftover reuse, realistic cooking time, nutrition balance, and respect for “I hate cilantro.” Generic LLM output feels cheap; you need constraints, user feedback loops, and a good recipe source.
Photographing the fridge weekly (or after shopping) is friction.
ChatGPT + a photo already does a decent one-off version. Grocery apps and meal-kit services are also moving this direction.
